brief:
Build a single-page Three.js shape carousel. Six platonic / topological solids, physical materials (pearl, gold, jade, glass, copper, obsidian), keyboard / wheel / drag / dot nav. ACES tone mapping, subtle film-grain overlay. Fraunces for display type, JetBrains Mono for labels.

The title MUST be a time-of-day phrase derived from current UTC ("Blue Hour", "Late Afternoon", "Witching Hour", "Cobalt Dusk"). Use it in BOTH the <title> tag and the header brand text.
design_system: Editorial-meets-three-js. Off-black background (#0a0a0d), warm pearl + cool blue palette. Generous whitespace around the carousel. ACES filmic tone mapping in the renderer. Subtle 1px film grain overlay via CSS.
required_elements: Dot nav strip showing position in the carousel
Fresh time-of-day title in <title> and header
